title: Repositioning
text: A long day repositioning from Maine Yacht Center, Portland to Salem, MA. We were off the dock by 0430 and motoring through dense fog until it broke about 1000.  Got to try the new code sail for a bit and mixed the day up with some sailing and motor sailing.  The winds were all over the place but always on our bow.  Glad to be back on the home mooring.

title: Sea trials
text: Out and back and around Salem, Manchester, and Marblehead. We spent a while in 25-32kt winds running the new jib through its paces, tuning the inner forestay and runners to match.  It’s a really nice upgrade from the excellent but blown out North 3Di. It’s got a higher clew which is great for seeing lobster pots and broader shoulders giving us a lot of options with car position.

title: Overnight to Somes Sound, MDI
text: Overnight run to MDI.  It was a nice overnight broad reach but died at sunrise once Cadillac and pots came into view
